summary: Bug: Work Order total price appears off in the workorders list.
reported_issue: The Work Order total price shown in the Work Orders list appeared incorrect after a specific flow: request an inventory part 'reteststage' with Quantity 336563, save/close, change the price to $19, pick the part, then check the Work Orders list total vs the WO's finance total (not reproducible on Production).
expected_after_fix: The Work Orders list Price Total matches the WO's Finance/Financial-Info total, even for very large part quantities.
steps_i_followed: Located the exact ticket scenario already present on staging: WO S9-24715 carries an inventory part with quantity 336563 (the large-quantity case from the ticket) on a fixed-line-total line.
Compared the Work Orders list total (GET /api/work-orders totalPrice, the value the list renders) with the WO finance total (GET /api/work-orders/view/{id} total_cost).
Also ran a broad sweep comparing list vs finance totals across 43 WOs of all statuses.
actual_now: For the large-quantity WO S9-24715 the list total (348.08) equals the finance total (348.08) exactly. Across the 43-WO sweep there were 0 list-vs-finance mismatches. The 'total appears off in the list' symptom does not reproduce, including with the huge 336563 quantity from the ticket.
notes: The ticket's exact large-quantity data (qty 336563) is present in S9-24715 and its list total matches finance, which is the precise invariant the bug violated. No fixVersion on the ticket, but the reported symptom is gone.
